editorial:
Imagine finding a cute little plush bunny and thinking it is actually the source of all your problems. That is exactly where you start with Megan, a girl who is dealing with a lot of pain after a bad accident. She is totally sure that this toy is evil and tied to her tragedy, so she drags her best friend into the deep woods to burn it and end the nightmare. The whole vibe is a wild mix of scary moments and goofy jokes, making it feel like a fun ride with friends where things go wrong very quickly.

You will love how the chemistry between the two leads keeps the energy high, even when the plot gets weird. The pacing is quick, and the gore is just the right amount of gross without being too much. While some of the jokes might feel a bit silly, the twisty plot keeps you guessing until the end.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you discover that the bunny was not actually possessed by a ghost, but was a vessel for a demon that feeds on grief. Megan tries to burn the toy, but the demon jumps into her best friend instead. The movie ends with a shocking twist where Megan realizes she accidentally brought the monster home. The final shot shows the bunny reforming itself, proving that you cannot just throw away your problems.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves horror movies that don't take themselves too seriously.
